data.narrative:
Science Corporation, a Series B biotech company founded by Max Hodak, has raised $230M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 8 private peers and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health. The private peer set spans Series B–C, including Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), New Limit ($3.1B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $437M. Peer-Median anchors to the 4-company comparables set, which has a median valuation of $3.5B and a range of $539M–$10.3B, directly implying $3.5B. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue data. The company's private status precludes meaningful P/S application across the 3 public biotech tickers tracked (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L; median P/S 6.6x).

The two applicable methods yield a wide triangulated range: low of $371M, median of $1.9B, and high of $4.0B. This dispersion reflects material uncertainty. The Stage-Progression result sits below the peer median, likely because the $230M raised proxy understates Science Corporation's demonstrated traction relative to later-stage peers. Peer clustering appears bimodal—three Series C rounds at $3–$10B versus Eikon at $539M—suggesting valuation hinges critically on Science Corporation's proprietary progress relative to nearer-stage comparables.
